← Reading Habit Coach

A few good questions.

Straight answers about your reading companion.

Do I need an account?

No. Your library, sessions, goals and notes are stored locally.

Does it work offline?

Core tracking and imported-document reading work offline. Optional metadata search requires the internet. Device speech services may also use the internet.

Can it open my Kindle purchases?

No. There is no authorised Kindle library integration and no DRM bypass. Import only compatible documents you are authorised to open.

Can I back up my reading history?

Export JSON metadata and notes, then import JSON to merge entries by ID. Document files are excluded. Exports are not encrypted. This build has no cloud backup provider.

Is it available in multiple languages?

The current interface is English. Translation infrastructure and a review report are included in the source; the target languages are not release-ready.

Where can I find the app?

Source and early-access build information are on GitHub. Amazon Appstore publication is pending.
